# Descriptions
@@ 1
This spell allows the caster to “turn off” the target Symbol I for the
duration of this spell. If the Symbol I fails an RR, it cannot be triggered or
its constant effects are not active for the duration of this spell. The
Symbol’s RR is based on the level of the spell in the Symbol spell (the
target’s level) and the level of the Bypass Symbol Spell (the attack level).
@@ 2
Caster can remove one Symbol I (an placed 1st level spell). The Symbol’s RR is
based on the level of the spell in the Symbol spell (the target’s level) and
the level of the Bypass Symbol Spell (the attack level).
@@ 3
Caster can emplace one 1st level spell on any 1 given non-mobile stone (see
below). Within one minute, the spell to be placed must also be cast (within
10’). The symbol is usually visible, but is only required to be visible if
reading is the trigger (see below). • The Symbol must be placed on a slab of
stone (block, piece, etc.) weighing at least 2,000 pounds. Only one Symbol may
be placed on each continuous slab. The stone may not be moved without
dispelling the Symbol. • A Symbol can be triggered by one of the following
(decided by caster): time period, specified movements, specified sounds,
touch, reading, violent actions in the area, etc. The triggering range is
normally 10’ or the range of the placed spell, whichever is larger. • If the
spell placed is an attack spell, the attack level is the spell’s level (i.e.,
for Symbol I that attack level is always 1st level, not the level of the
caster). If the spell is an elemental attack, the OB is normally +0. However,
the attack can be focused on a location (as opposed to simply the person who
triggers the symbol). In this case the OB is +50. • Normally, if the Symbol
affects a being or thing (e.g., healing, attacks, etc.), it can be triggered
only once per day.
@@ 4
Allows the caster to connect one surface or trigger to a symbol that is
normally outside of range of the symbol. For example, manipulating a door and
lock mechanism in one room could trigger a Light Symbol on the other side of
the building, bringing someone to investigate. The distance between the
trigger and the symbol can be up to 1 foot per level. Symbol Extension must be
in place before the symbol to use it is inscribed or imbedded.
@@ 5
As Bypass Symbol I, except affects up to a Symbol III.
@@ 6
As Unsymbol I, except affects up to a Symbol III.
@@ 7
As Symbol I, except emplaces up to a 3rd level spell.
@@ 8
As Bypass Symbol I, except affects up to a Symbol V.
@@ 9
As Unsymbol I, except affects up to a Symbol V.
@@ 10
As Symbol I, except emplaces up to a 5th level spell.
@@ 11
As Bypass Symbol I, except affects up to a Symbol VIII.
@@ 12
As Symbol I, except emplaces up to a 8th level spell.
@@ 13
As Unsymbol I, except affects up to a Symbol VIII.
@@ 14
As Bypass Symbol I, except affects up to a Symbol X.
@@ 15
As Symbol I, except emplaces up to a 10th level spell.
@@ 16
As Unsymbol I, except affects up to a Symbol X.
@@ 17
As Bypass Symbol I, except affects up to a Symbol XIII.
@@ 18
As Symbol I, except emplaces up to a 13th level spell.
@@ 19
As Unsymbol I, except affects up to a Symbol XIII.
@@ 20
As Symbol I, except caster can emplace any spell less than his level.
@@ 25
Allows caster to modify any imbed symbol spell on this list to allow it to be
imbedded on a mobile surface. The resulting sign will remain potent until it
is triggered. The mobile surface must be non-living and must weigh at least
100 pounds. A given spell caster can only have one mobile sign per level of
experience (subsequent castings will cause the oldest castings to dispel).
@@ 30
As Unsymbol I, except caster can remove any spell of a level less than his own
(e.g., a 50th level caster could remove a 49th level spell, but not a 50th
level spell).
@@ 50
As Inscribe Sign, except target must be a living creature and must weigh at
least 50 pounds. The sign will remain potent until triggered. Often these
signs are disguised by incorporating them with existing tattoos.
